pictures.name: waking_light
pictures.scene: a wide valley just filling with the first light of morning, mist still lying low and pale along its floor at the bottom of the frame, the far slopes above it half seen and dim as something remembered

pictures.name: spring_breaking_out
pictures.scene: clear water bursting up out of dry cracked ground into a bright shallow pool, the spray lit white and gold along the bottom of the frame, the parched plain beyond it lying flat and dark and silent

pictures.name: far_hills_hearing
pictures.scene: a great open plain seen from a low rise with range after range of hills fading away to a distant horizon, the near grass lit warm and gold, everything beyond it quiet and blue and without detail

pictures.name: full_measure
pictures.scene: a wide shallow basket heaped over its brim with ripe grain, the topmost ears lit warm from one side at the bottom of the frame, the threshing floor around it stretching away into soft brown shade

pictures.name: wadi_running_again
pictures.scene: a dry desert watercourse suddenly running full, brown water threading bright between pale banks along the bottom of the frame, the great red wilderness above and beyond it empty and dim and still

pictures.name: wet_furrow
pictures.scene: one long dark furrow newly opened in heavy wet earth, its turned soil glistening under low grey light at the bottom of the frame, the unbroken field beyond it going flat and colourless to a far edge

pictures.name: scattered_seed
pictures.scene: a scatter of pale seed lying along the bottom of a fresh furrow, each grain catching a thin low light, the long dark reach of turned earth above it running away empty toward a cold far horizon

pictures.name: sheaves_stacked
pictures.scene: a tall stook of bound wheat sheaves standing alone in a cut field, its straw burning gold in the last low sun at the bottom of the frame, the stubble beyond it darkening quietly toward evening

lines.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion,
Then our mouths were filled with laughter,
our tongues with shouts of joy.
Then it was said among the nations,
“The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us;
will reap with shouts of joy.
will surely return with shouts of joy,
